import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, val, w;
        public Edge(int to, int next, int val, int w) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.val = val;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        int c, f;
        public Flow(int c, int f) {
            this.c = c;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 5005;
    static final int INF = (int)1e9;
    static int n, m, k, c, d, s, t, total, edgeCount;
    static int[] pre = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static Edge[] edges;
    static int[][] E = new int[MAXN][2];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        edges[++edgeCount] = new Edge(v, head[u], val, w);
        head[u] = edgeCount;
    }

    static void add(int u, int v, int val, int w) {
        addEdge(u, v, val, w);
        addEdge(v, u, 0, -w);
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, 1, total + 1, INF);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            visited[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edges[i].next) {
                int v = edges[i].to;
                if (edges[i].val > 0 && dist[v] > dist[u] + edges[i].w) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + edges[i].w;
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (!visited[v]) {
                        visited[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] < INF;
    }

    static Flow minCostMaxFlow() {
        int totalCost = 0, totalFlow = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int flowAmount = INF;
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edges[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
                flowAmount = Math.min(flowAmount, edges[pre[x]].val);
            }
            for (int x = t; x != s; x = edges[pre[x] ^ 1].to) {
                edges[pre[x]].val -= flowAmount;
                edges[pre[x] ^ 1].val += flowAmount;
            }
            totalFlow += flowAmount;
            totalCost += dist[t] * flowAmount;
        }
        return new Flow(totalCost, totalFlow);
    }

    static int IDX(int i, int j) {
        return i * n + j;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int sourceOffset = 2 * k;
        total = sourceOffset * n;
        edges = new Edge[MAXM << 1];
        Arrays.fill(head, 0);
        edgeCount = 1;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        s = ++total;
        t = ++total;

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int tp = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            add(s, IDX(0, tp), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            E[i][0] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            E[i][1] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= sourceOffset - 1; i++) {
            add(IDX(i, 1), t, k, c * i);
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                add(IDX(i - 1, j), IDX(i, j), k, 0);
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= m; j++) {
                for (int tIdx = 1; tIdx <= k; tIdx++) {
                    int cost = (2 * tIdx - 1) * d;
                    add(IDX(i - 1, E[j][0]), IDX(i, E[j][1]), 1, cost);
                    add(IDX(i - 1, E[j][1]), IDX(i, E[j][0]), 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }

        Flow result = minCostMaxFlow();
        System.out.println(result.c);
    }
}
